```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull_requests: write

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]' && github.event_name == 'issues' && contains(github.event.issue.title, '@claude') || github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        run: npm run claudie-code-review -- --issue-number ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --repo-token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Respond to comment
        if: github.event_name == 'issues' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')
        run: npm run claudie-code-review -- --comment-id ${{ github.event.comment.id }} --repo-token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
